name: Shaker Furniture of Maine
old_description: Explore two floors and nearly 10,000 square feet of bedrooms, living rooms, dining tables and chairs, and accent pieces crafted from native hardwoods such as cherry, maple, and oak. We stock plenty of classic pine furniture too, carefully prefinished or ready for paint/stain. Every single piece is solid wood, and made with pride in American shops.
about:
Shaker Furniture of Maine operates from a two-floor, nearly 10,000-square-foot showroom on Route 1 in Scarborough, Maine. The business is led by proprietor Steve Celona, who emphasizes American-made craftsmanship.

The company offers solid wood furniture crafted from native hardwoods including cherry, maple, and oak, as well as classic pine pieces. Every piece is solid wood, made in American shops, and available prefinished or ready for paint or stain. The shop also provides custom building to customer specifications. The facility spans two floors and nearly 10,000 square feet, displaying bedrooms, living rooms, dining sets, and accent pieces.

Shaker Furniture of Maine serves residential customers nationwide, shipping furniture across the United States. Its showroom caters to homeowners seeking bedroom, living room, dining, and occasional furniture, with an emphasis on personal service and value-driven pricing.

The company differentiates itself with a "Made in Maine and Made in America" commitment, highlighting solid wood construction, timeless designs, and expert personal service as the foundation of its shopping experience. Celona states the goal is to introduce comfortable, lasting furniture to enhance life at home.
